provenance.source_title: Your Life After Marrying Into a Billionaire Family

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个物件细节写尽人物的经济层
examples.expression_mechanism: 贫困指纹（10万英里+亮一年的故障灯）
examples.example_text: Your car has over 100,000 miles on it. The check engine light has been on for a year.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「拖了一年没修的小毛病」代替收入数字写窘迫
examples.negative_instruction: 细节必须是主人已习惯忽略的东西，不可写成突发事故

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个小动作埋下她的善意密码
examples.expression_mechanism: 延迟解码（最便宜的意面→她在体谅你）
examples.example_text: She orders the cheapest pasta on the menu. You don't understand why until later. She is being kind.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先写动作再延迟揭义，让温柔自己显形
examples.negative_instruction: 揭义必须简短（三个字式），不可展开赞美

examples.psychological_goal: 用身体反应写发现的重量
examples.expression_mechanism: 身体化震惊（胃里一沉直坠地板）
examples.example_text: you type her last name into a search bar. Your stomach drops straight through the floor.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把「查到真相」写成日常动作+身体反应，而非心理描述
examples.negative_instruction: 身体反应必须极端但常见，不可造陌生比喻

examples.psychological_goal: 用一组数字对照刻出两个世界
examples.expression_mechanism: 购买力换算（$4,000戒指 vs 一万个不眨眼）
examples.example_text: The ring costs $4,000 and it terrifies you. You know her father could buy 10,000 of them and not notice.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用同一件商品在两种购买力下的意义差写阶层差
examples.negative_instruction: 换算必须同单位（个数），不可只写「他家很有钱」

examples.psychological_goal: 给幸福感装上倒计时
examples.expression_mechanism: 幸福限时器（这感觉维持约1周）
examples.example_text: You feel like the richest man who ever lived. That feeling lasts about 1 week.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在情绪最高点的下一句立刻给限时，落差即转场
examples.negative_instruction: 限时必须精确短促，不可写「好景不长」

examples.psychological_goal: 用否定句升级量级
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定升级（不是房子，是compound）
examples.example_text: The house is not a house. It is a compound with wings and a name.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「不是X，是Y」把日常名词升级为特权名词
examples.negative_instruction: Y必须带具体特征（翼楼/名字），不可只写「很大」

examples.psychological_goal: 用不道歉的平静写出人物脊梁
examples.expression_mechanism: 平静陈述+不道歉标记（修了三十年空调）
examples.example_text: Your father fixed air conditioners for 30 years. You say it plainly and you do not apologize for it.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习让人物用平实的陈述通过尊严考验
examples.negative_instruction: 不道歉必须靠陈述语气体现，不可让角色发表自尊演说

examples.psychological_goal: 一句话定义「家人名义下的受审感」
examples.expression_mechanism: 错置比喻（晚饭=没申请过的面试）
examples.example_text: Every dinner is a job interview you never applied for.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把日常场景重命名为一场非自愿的考核
examples.negative_instruction: 比喻两端必须是高频日常（晚饭/面试），不可生僻

examples.psychological_goal: 把隐形规则写成一门语言
examples.expression_mechanism: 无词语言（眼神/沉默/座次）
examples.example_text: The language has no actual words. It is made of glances and silences and who gets seated where.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「没有单词的语言」概括圈层潜规则
examples.negative_instruction: 组成项必须都是非语言信号，不可混入真术语

examples.psychological_goal: 用最小单位给进展定价
examples.expression_mechanism: 最小单位判词（一寸就是一切）
examples.example_text: You earn an inch of his trust. An inch is everything.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把巨大进展换算成最小单位，反而放大其重量
examples.negative_instruction: 单位必须与上下文尺度呼应（inch），不可随口取量词

examples.psychological_goal: 让保护欲的半径超过忠诚
examples.expression_mechanism: 保护清单的越界项（包括这个家族）
examples.example_text: You will protect this child from everything, including this family if you must.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在誓言清单末尾加一个「不该出现」的对象制造张力
examples.negative_instruction: 越界项必须与人物所处阵营一致，不可为反转而反转

examples.psychological_goal: 用「区分」句给人物策略定性
examples.expression_mechanism: 用法区分定成败（保护而非威胁）
examples.example_text: You use it to protect the family. That distinction earns you everything.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习同一种资源两种用法，把成败归因到用法之别
examples.negative_instruction: 必须先建立资源（知识/秘密），再谈用法区分

examples.psychological_goal: 给出灭火者的核心洞察
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定表层+三词真因（不关钱，关骄傲恐惧被听见）
examples.example_text: most problems are never about money. They are about pride and fear and the need to be heard.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「从不关X，关乎A、B和C」把谈判智慧压成一句
examples.negative_instruction: 真因必须是情绪层名词，不可换成策略层术语

examples.psychological_goal: 用空间比喻给爱情定锚
examples.expression_mechanism: 空间化爱人（最喜欢的房间）
examples.example_text: She is still your favorite room in the world.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用住所/空间比喻亲密关系，与财富意象（房子/庄园）暗暗对打
examples.negative_instruction: 比喻必须与全片空间母题一致，不可随手取喻

examples.psychological_goal: 用缺席者写出阶层的墙
examples.expression_mechanism: 缺席即证词（没人来工人的葬礼）
examples.example_text: None of the billionaires came to a working man's funeral.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习不写评价只写谁没来，让缺席自己下判词
examples.negative_instruction: 句子必须止于事实，不可加「可见人情冷暖」

examples.psychological_goal: 把怜悯重定义为权力的奢侈品
examples.expression_mechanism: 价值重排（怜悯=权力才负担得起的奢侈）
examples.example_text: That mercy is not weakness. It is the one true luxury that real power can afford you.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先否定一个误读（软弱），再给出翻转的奢侈品定义
examples.negative_instruction: 奢侈品定义必须与全片财富语境呼应，不可泛化为鸡汤

examples.psychological_goal: 用同一词的正反写传承悖论
examples.expression_mechanism: 同词对仗（血建起它，血撑不住它）
examples.example_text: blood built this empire, but blood will not keep it standing.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用同一个词承担建与毁两个角色，一句话写完传承悖论
examples.negative_instruction: 对仗两半必须分别被前文证据支撑（创业史/继承人失败）

examples.psychological_goal: 用否定宏大来回扣最初的小
examples.expression_mechanism: 王座/女孩对置（从未想要王座，只要咖啡店的女孩）
examples.example_text: You never wanted a throne. You only wanted that girl from the coffee shop.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在权力顶点用「只想要最初的小东西」完成人物收束
examples.negative_instruction: 最初的小东西必须是开场建立过的意象，不可临时造

examples.psychological_goal: 用天气比喻给一生财富降级
examples.expression_mechanism: 降级重锤（其他一切都只是天气）
examples.example_text: Everything else was just weather. The fortune was never the prize. She was.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一个降级比喻+一个指人的单字句做主题收束
examples.negative_instruction: 单字句（She was.）必须独立落下，不可接解释

examples.psychological_goal: 用场景复制把结局接回开头
examples.expression_mechanism: 循环回收（另一个年轻人+咖啡店+还未知的姓）
examples.example_text: Somewhere out there, a young man is sitting across from a woman in a coffee shop. He doesn't know her last name yet.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把开场场景复制给一个新人物，让个案变成循环警示
examples.negative_instruction: 复制元素必须与开场一一对应（咖啡店/姓氏），不可只写「还有别人」
